card.name: Words just before treatment or use
card.fires_on: Modifier words or word endings that sit right before a noun like treatment, therapy, use or a drug name, in warning text. Examples are 'antipsychotic', 'peritoneal', 'administered' and 'include the'.

modes.example: Tardive dyskinesia may remit, partially or completely, if antipsych<<otic>> treatment is withdrawn.
